extracted.stage: Estate administration; property not yet sold
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid Harrogate estate worth about £640,000 enquires about borrowing £45,000 for professional fees and tax pending sale of the house.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding a probate loan for the executors of the Harrogate estate. We have noted the estimated estate value of £640,000 and the £45,000 sought for professional fees and tax pending the sale of the property. To take this further we would need confirmation of the grant of probate position, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, details of any inheritance tax deadline, the names and contact details of all executors, and confirmation of your firm's role in the administration. Once we have those details a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
